topics.blurb: Three built-in safety systems, and the three ways drivers get them wrong.

concepts.label: Who designated spaces are reserved for
concepts.statement: Designated mobility impaired parking spaces are reserved for people whose condition limits their ability to walk reasonable distances.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: These areas are reserved for those having a condition which limits their ability to walk reasonable distances.

concepts.label: People who transport the mobility impaired may use a space
concepts.statement: Citizens who routinely transport mobility impaired persons may also use a designated parking space.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: citizens or those who routinely transport mobility impaired persons may also use a designated parking space.

concepts.label: A doctor must certify the condition
concepts.statement: To get a mobility impaired placard or plate you must have a doctor certify your condition on a form provided by the DMV.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: You must have a doctor certify your condition on a form provided by the DMV.

concepts.label: The $10.50 plate transfer fee
concepts.statement: There is a $10.50 transfer fee for the mobility impaired license plate.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: There is a $10.50 transfer fee for the mobility impaired license plate.

concepts.label: Parking in a designated space without a placard is illegal
concepts.statement: It is illegal to park a vehicle that does not display a mobility impaired parking placard or license plate in a designated area.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: It is illegal to park a vehicle that does not display a mobility impaired parking placard or license plate in a designated area.

concepts.label: A letter should accompany the application
concepts.statement: An applicant whose physical disability or medical problem may interfere with driving should prepare a letter explaining the situation to accompany the application.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: If you have a physical disability or medical problem that may interfere with your driving ability, you should prepare a letter explaining the situation to accompany your application.

concepts.label: Where to get a list of adaptive driving aids
concepts.statement: A list of manufacturers that provide adaptive driving aids can be obtained from your driver's license examiner.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.sourceQuote: you can get a list of manufacturers that provide driving aids from your driver’s license examiner

concepts.label: Ask for an accommodation 48 hours ahead
concepts.statement: Anyone needing an auxiliary aid, service or a change of procedure should contact the DMV no later than 48 hours before their scheduled arrival.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.chapterTitle: Traffic Laws and Rules of the Road
source.section: Notice on ADA Compliance and Grievances
source.sourceQuote: should contact the DMV no later than 48 hours before the scheduled arrival to DMV.

concepts.label: Head restraints exist to reduce whiplash
concepts.statement: Head restraints are designed to reduce the chance of whiplash injury in rear-end collisions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Head restraints are designed to reduce the chance of whiplash injury in rear-end collisions.

concepts.label: A head restraint goes against the back of the head
concepts.statement: An adjustable head restraint should be positioned to fit against the back of your head, not your neck.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If adjustable, they should be positioned to fit against the back of your head, not your neck.

concepts.label: ABS prevents wheel lockup
concepts.statement: The anti-lock brake system is designed to prevent wheel lockup when a motorist must come to a quick stop.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The ABS is designed to prevent wheel lockup in the event a motorist must come to a quick stop.

concepts.label: ABS is about keeping control, not stopping shorter
concepts.statement: ABS provides drivers with the ability to maintain control over their vehicles while coming to an abrupt stop.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: the ABS is a safety feature which provides drivers with the ability to maintain control over their vehicles while coming to an abrupt stop.

concepts.label: With ABS: steer and push hard on the brake
concepts.statement: In a vehicle with ABS the driver must continue to steer while pushing hard on the brake.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: When applying the brake in a vehicle that has an ABS, the driver must continue to steer the vehicle while pushing hard on the brake.

concepts.label: Never pump ABS brakes
concepts.statement: Pumping the brake in an ABS-equipped vehicle reduces the system's ability to stop safely, and a driver can lose all brake force by doing it.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: In fact, a driver can lose all brake force by pumping ABS brakes.

concepts.label: ABS improves stopping by about 10 percent at best
concepts.statement: In a sudden stop the ABS will improve performance by only about 10 percent at best, so it is not a licence to take risks.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: in the event of a sudden stop, the ABS will improve performance by only about 10 percent at best.

concepts.label: Air bags do not replace seat belts
concepts.statement: A majority of those killed by air bags were not wearing their seat belts, so belts must be worn at all times in an air bag vehicle.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: It is important to note that a majority of those killed by air bags were not wearing their seat belts.

concepts.label: Hands at 4 and 8 o’clock in an air bag vehicle
concepts.statement: The safest steering wheel hand placement is right hand at 4 o'clock and left hand at 8 o'clock, so the arms are not between the air bag and the body.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: the safest placement is right hand at 4 o'clock and left hand at 8 o'clock.

concepts.label: Never a rear-facing infant seat in front of an air bag
concepts.statement: If the vehicle has a passenger-side air bag, an infant in a rear-facing safety seat must never be placed in the front passenger seat.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Risk Reduction for Infants and Toddlers
source.sourceQuote: If a vehicle is equipped with a passenger-side air bag, under NO circumstances should an infant in a rear-facing safety seat be placed in the front passenger seat.

concepts.label: Children 12 and under belong in the rear seat
concepts.statement: All children 12 and under should be buckled and placed in the rear seat.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Risk Reduction for Infants and Toddlers
source.sourceQuote: it is recommended that all children 12 and under should be buckled and placed in the rear seat.

concepts.label: Doors locked, windows up
concepts.statement: Keep your vehicle doors locked and the windows up when driving or when parked.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: 8 Simple Steps to Safe and Happy Driving
source.sourceQuote: Keep your vehicle doors locked and the windows up when driving or when parked.

concepts.label: Deal with the phone before you move
concepts.statement: Turn off your wireless communication device, or enable the hands-free function, before driving.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: 8 Simple Steps to Safe and Happy Driving
source.sourceQuote: Turn off your wireless communication device, or enable the hands-free function before driving.

concepts.label: Valuables go in the trunk or glove compartment
concepts.statement: Lock purses, wallets, luggage and valuables in the trunk or glove compartment.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: 8 Simple Steps to Safe and Happy Driving
source.sourceQuote: Lock purses, wallets, luggage, and valuables in the trunk or glove compartment.

concepts.label: If lost, do not stop on the roadside
concepts.statement: If you become lost, do not pull over on the side of the road to study your map or directions; drive to the nearest well-lit, populated, public place instead.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: 8 Simple Steps to Safe and Happy Driving
source.sourceQuote: Should you become lost, do not pull over on the side of the road to study your map or directions.

concepts.label: Park in the light and approach with your keys ready
concepts.statement: Always park in well-lit areas, have your keys in hand when approaching the vehicle, and check inside and underneath before entering.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: 8 Simple Steps to Safe and Happy Driving
source.sourceQuote: Always park in well-lit areas and make sure you have your keys in hand when approaching your vehicle.

concepts.label: If you think you are being followed
concepts.statement: If you feel you are being followed, proceed to a well-lit populated area and call the police.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: 8 Simple Steps to Safe and Happy Driving
source.sourceQuote: In the rare event you feel you are being followed, proceed to a well-lit populated area and call the police.

concepts.label: What the Courtesy Patrol does
concepts.statement: The WV Courtesy Patrol assists stranded motorists, removes hazards from the roadway to reduce secondary crashes, and provides gas or directions.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The WVCP assists stranded motorists, removes hazards from the roadway thereby reducing the chance of secondary crashes, provides gas or directions

concepts.label: The Courtesy Patrol number
concepts.statement: The Courtesy Patrol is reached by dialing 1-800-964-1449, and the handbook says to store the number on your cell phone.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The Courtesy Patrol can be reached by dialing 1-800-964-1449.  Store this number on your cell phone in case of emergency.

concepts.label: How to wait for help
concepts.statement: Pull off the highway as far as possible, keep your doors locked, and be aware of who pulls up behind you.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Pull off  of the highway as far as possible.

concepts.label: The operator approaches on the passenger side
concepts.statement: A Courtesy Patrol driver will approach you on the passenger side of the vehicle if at all possible.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The driver will approach you on the passenger side of the vehicle if at all possible.

concepts.label: Littering is against West Virginia law
concepts.statement: It is a violation of West Virginia law to litter public or private roadways or public or private property.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: It is a violation of West Virginia law to litter public or private roadways or public/private property.

concepts.label: The fine and jail term for littering
concepts.statement: On conviction for littering an individual can be fined not less than $50 nor more than $1,000, or imprisoned in the county jail for not more than 60 days.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: not less than $50 nor more than $1,000,  imprisoned in the county jail for not more than 60 days

concepts.label: One oil change can ruin a million gallons of water
concepts.statement: Dumped in a lake, the oil from a single oil change (about a gallon) can ruin a million gallons of water.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: If dumped in a lake, the oil from a single oil change (about a gallon) can ruin a million gallons of water.

concepts.label: Battery retailers must recycle old batteries
concepts.statement: Battery retailers are required by law to recycle old batteries upon request.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Battery retailers are required by law to recycle old batteries upon request.

concepts.label: Every Social Security number is checked with the SSA
concepts.statement: The DMV checks every Social Security number with the SSA, and your full legal name must match your name on file there.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Proof Documents Required to Obtain a Driver’s License
source.sourceQuote: The DMV checks every social security number with the SSA.

concepts.label: Souvenir and Minister’s marriage copies are not accepted
concepts.statement: A marriage certificate is needed for each marriage if married more than once, and souvenir documents and Minister's copies are not acceptable.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Proof Documents Required to Obtain a Driver’s License
source.sourceQuote: For each marriage if married more than once, also souvenir documents and Minister's copies are not acceptable

concepts.label: A married applicant may use a spouse’s residency documents
concepts.statement: Married applicants may provide WV residency documents in their spouse's name when accompanied by a marriage certificate.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Acceptable Proof of West Virginia Residency
source.sourceQuote: Married applicants may provide WV residency documents in their spouse’s name when accompanied with a Marriage Certificate.

concepts.label: An unsettled problem elsewhere blocks a WV licence
concepts.statement: The DMV is prohibited from licensing any driver whose driving history reflects an unsettled problem in another state or jurisdiction.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: National Driver Registry: Problem Driver Point System (PDPS)
source.sourceQuote: The DMV is prohibited from licensing any driver whose driving history reflects an unsettled problem in another state or jurisdiction.

concepts.label: An unpaid out-of-state citation suspends your WV licence
concepts.statement: West Virginia will suspend your driver's license if another state notifies the DMV that you failed to pay a citation issued there.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: National Driver Registry: Problem Driver Point System (PDPS)
source.sourceQuote: West Virginia DMV will suspend  your  driver's  license  if  we  receive  notice  from  another  state  that  you  have  failed  to  pay  a citation issued in another state or jurisdiction.

concepts.label: You cannot renew a WV card from out of state
concepts.statement: Nonresidents who previously lived in WV may not renew their WV licence or ID card until they again establish residency in the state.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Acceptable Proof of West Virginia Residency
source.sourceQuote: Nonresidents who previously resided in WV and were licensed or issued an identification card in WV may not renew their WV driver's licenses or identification cards until they again establish residency in this state.

concepts.label: A certified driving record can waive retesting
concepts.statement: A new resident who cannot produce their out-of-state licence must obtain a certified driving record from the previous state in order to waive the testing requirement.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: A new resident who cannot provide their out-of-state driver’s license must obtain a certified driving record from the state or jurisdiction in which they were previously licensed in order to waive the testing requirement.

concepts.label: Driving on a suspended out-of-state licence is illegal here
concepts.statement: It is illegal to drive in WV with a suspended or revoked driver's license from any other state or jurisdiction.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: It is illegal to drive in WV with a suspended or revoked driver’s license from any other state or jurisdiction.

concepts.label: Married under-18 applicants need no parental consent
concepts.statement: Parental consent is not required for married applicants under 18, but a certified copy of the marriage certificate must be presented.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Parental  consent  is  not  required  for  married applicants  under  the  age  of  18; however, you must present a certified copy of your marriage certificate.

concepts.label: The online test certificate is not permission to drive
concepts.statement: The certificate received from the online knowledge test is not permission to drive; the applicant must go to a DMV location for processing.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: THE CERTIFICATE RECEIVED FROM THIS TEST IS NOT PERMISSION TO DRIVE. YOU MUST GO TO A DMV LOCATION FOR PROCESSING.

concepts.label: A 30-day grace period past the 18th birthday
concepts.statement: A Level 1 GDL instruction permit expires on the 18th birthday, but a 30-day grace period beyond it is allowed to complete the road skills examination.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: to allow sufficient time to complete the Road Skills Examination, a 30-day grace period (beyond the applicant’s 18th birthday) will be allowed.

concepts.label: Driver education is an alternative to the 50-hour log
concepts.statement: The Level 2 behind-the-wheel requirement can be met either by a certified 50-hour log or by completing a driver's education course approved by the West Virginia Department of Education.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: or complete a driver's education course approved by the West Virginia Department of Education

concepts.label: A first Level 2 conviction means a driver improvement program
concepts.statement: A Level 2 holder must enroll in a driver improvement program on the first conviction, and failing to enroll keeps them at Level 2 until age 18.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Levels 1 and 2 GDL Violations and Convictions
source.sourceQuote: Level 2 GDL intermediate driver's license holders are required to enroll in a driver improvement program upon the first conviction.

concepts.label: Applying for Level 3 is the driver’s choice
concepts.statement: Once eligible for Level 3 it is the driver's option to apply for it or to keep the Level 2 licence and its restrictions until age 18.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: it is the driver’s option to apply for this driver’s license or to keep the Level 2 GDL and follow its restrictions until they are 18 years of age.

concepts.label: 30-day grace on 18th and 21st birthday expirations
concepts.statement: Licences expiring on a licensee's 18th or 21st birthday carry a 30-day grace period so the bearer can obtain the appropriate colour licence.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Driver’s licenses expiring on a licensee’s 18th or 21st birthday will have a 30-day grace period to allow the bearer to obtain the appropriate color license.

concepts.label: Renewal fees run at $5.00 per year
concepts.statement: Renewal fees are based on the number of years until your age is divisible by five, at a rate of $5.00 per year.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: at a rate of $5.00 per year.  For example, if you are 21 years old when you renew your driver’s license, it will next expire on your 25th birthday and the fee would be $20.00

concepts.label: Changing the donor mark on the card needs a new card
concepts.statement: You may join or leave the organ donor registry online at any time, but changing the designation on the face of the card requires obtaining a new licence and paying any applicable fees.

lessons.plainEnglish:
West Virginia sets aside marked parking spaces for mobility impaired citizens. The test is not a diagnosis or a wheelchair: it is a condition that limits the person's ability to walk reasonable distances. The permission travels with the person, not only with the driver, so someone who routinely transports a mobility impaired person may use a designated space too.

Getting the permission is a medical step, not a paperwork step. A doctor certifies your condition on a form the DMV provides, and the DMV issues the placard and/or the plate after approving your application. The plate carries a $10.50 transfer fee. Once spaces are designated, parking there in a vehicle that shows neither a placard nor a mobility impaired plate is illegal.

The handbook also speaks to drivers with disabilities generally. If a physical disability or medical problem may interfere with your driving, prepare a letter explaining the situation to go with your application, and if you need hand controls or similar equipment your driver's license examiner can give you a list of manufacturers. If you need an auxiliary aid, a service, or a change to normal DMV procedure, ask at least 48 hours before you are due at the office.
lessons.whyItMatters:
Disability parking is one of the few parking rules with a criminal penalty attached to a space that often looks empty and convenient. Knowing that the space is reserved by a condition rather than by a label stops the two common errors: assuming a placard is only for wheelchair users, and assuming it is fine to use the space 'just for a minute'.

The 48-hour notice matters for a different reason. A learner who needs an audio exam, an interpreter or a modified procedure and turns up expecting it on the day may be sent home; the handbook tells you to ask ahead.
lessons.example: You drive your grandmother, who cannot walk far, to her appointments most weeks. She has a mobility impaired placard. Because you routinely transport a mobility impaired person and her placard is displayed, you may use a designated space when she is with you. Park in the same space on a day you are collecting your own shopping alone and, with no placard or plate displayed, you are parked illegally.

lessons.plainEnglish:
Three systems, three misunderstandings. The head restraint is not a headrest for comfort: it is there to stop your head snapping backwards in a rear-end collision, which is what causes whiplash. It only does that if it sits against the back of your head. Set too low it catches your neck, and a restraint behind your neck is a pivot rather than a support.

Anti-lock brakes prevent the wheels locking when you have to stop suddenly. That is a steering benefit, not a stopping-distance benefit. The handbook is blunt: ABS improves performance by only about 10 percent at best, and it does not provide brakes that stop a vehicle on a dime. What it buys you is the ability to keep steering while you brake hard, which is exactly what drivers were taught NOT to do in the days of pumping the pedal. In an ABS vehicle, pumping reduces the system's ability to stop you, and the handbook says a driver can lose all brake force that way.

Air bags work with seat belts, not instead of them; the handbook notes a majority of those killed by air bags were not belted. Hold the wheel from the side, right hand at 4 o'clock and left at 8 o'clock, so a deploying bag does not drive your own arms into your face, and tilt both front seats slightly back for room. An infant in a rear-facing seat must never go in front of a passenger-side air bag, and all children 12 and under belong in the rear seat.
lessons.whyItMatters:
Each of these features can be defeated by the driver. A head restraint at the wrong height, ABS treated like old-fashioned brakes, or an air bag trusted instead of a belt turns protective equipment into a disappointment at the worst possible moment.

The ABS rule is the one that changes behaviour under stress: the instinct drilled into older drivers was to pump. Learning that you now push hard and steer, deliberately, before you need to, is what makes the system work when a car pulls out in front of you.
lessons.example: A child runs out and you brake hard in an ABS car. The pedal shudders and buzzes under your foot. That is the system working, not failing. Keep the pedal pressed hard and steer around the child: because the wheels are not locked, the car still answers the wheel. Lift off and start pumping and you throw away both the braking and the steering the system was giving you.

lessons.plainEnglish:
This part of the handbook is about crime rather than collisions, and it is built on one idea: stay where there are lights and people. Doors locked and windows up whenever the vehicle is moving or parked. Purses, wallets, luggage and anything else worth stealing out of sight in the trunk or the glove compartment, not on the passenger seat.

The phone is handled before you move, not while you are moving: turn the device off, or enable the hands-free function, before driving. That is also the law in West Virginia, so the safety advice and the traffic law point the same way.

Two situations get specific instructions. If you are lost, the roadside is the wrong place to stop and read directions; drive on to the nearest well-lit, populated, public place such as a service station or restaurant, and lock the vehicle and take the keys when you get out. If you feel you are being followed, do not drive home and do not confront anyone: go to a well-lit populated area and call the police, which in most of the United States means dialling 9-1-1.

Coming back to a parked car has its own routine. Park in a well-lit area, have your keys in hand as you approach so you are not searching for them beside the car, and check inside and underneath before you get in.
lessons.whyItMatters:
Almost every step here costs nothing and has to be decided in advance, because the moment you need it is the moment you are least able to think. A driver who has already decided that the answer to 'I am lost' is 'find a service station' does not end up parked on a dark verge with an interior light on.

The handbook also folds the hands-free law into this list, which is a reminder that the phone rule is not only about distraction: dealing with the device before you move removes one more reason to pull over somewhere unsuitable.
lessons.example: You realise you have missed your turning on an unfamiliar road after dark. The instinct is to pull onto the verge and look at your phone. The handbook says not to: keep driving to the nearest well-lit, populated, public place such as a service station or restaurant, park there, lock the car and take your keys, and work out the route in the light with people around.

lessons.plainEnglish:
The West Virginia Courtesy Patrol is a free roadside service on the state's interstates and corridors. It assists stranded motorists, removes hazards from the roadway so that a breakdown does not turn into a second crash, and provides gas or directions. It works alongside the State Police, 911 Centers and other emergency and highway personnel rather than replacing them.

You reach it by dialling 1-800-964-1449, and the handbook's advice is to store that number in your phone now rather than looking for it while stranded.

While you wait, the safety routine is the same one that runs through the rest of the handbook. Pull off the highway as far as possible so you are clear of moving traffic. Keep your doors locked and pay attention to who pulls up behind you. When the Courtesy Patrol arrives you will see a white pickup truck with a flashing orange bar light, and the operator wears a reflective vest and carries an identification badge. Expect them to come to your passenger side if at all possible, because that side is away from traffic.
lessons.whyItMatters:
A breakdown is the moment a driver is most exposed: stationary, distracted and beside moving traffic. Knowing in advance that there is a number to call, and that the person who arrives will be in a marked white pickup and approach from the passenger side, lets you tell real help from a stranger without having to decide under pressure.

The hazard-removal part matters for everyone else too. Secondary crashes happen when traffic piles into the debris or the stopped vehicle from an earlier incident, which is why clearing the roadway is treated as being as important as helping the individual driver.
lessons.example: You run out of fuel on an interstate. You coast off the highway as far as possible, stay in the vehicle with the doors locked, and call 1-800-964-1449. A white pickup with a flashing orange bar light pulls in behind you and a person in a reflective vest walks up to your passenger window. That is what the handbook says to expect, and gas is one of the things the Courtesy Patrol can provide.

source.sourceQuote: Battery retailers are required by law to recycle old batteries upon request.

lessons.plainEnglish:
Littering in West Virginia is not a matter of tidiness, it is a violation of law, and the law covers private property and private roadways as well as public ones. The penalties on conviction run from a fine of not less than $50 to not more than $1,000, or imprisonment in the county jail for not more than 60 days, and a court can instead order the offender to remove litter from roadways.

The handbook then deals with the waste a vehicle produces, naming four products as the biggest threats: dirty motor oil, old tires, antifreeze and batteries. The scale is worth remembering. A single oil change is about a gallon of oil, and dumped in a lake that gallon can ruin a million gallons of water. Illegally stockpiled tires collect water, attract mosquitoes and become a temptation for arsonists. Antifreeze is listed as a hazardous waste by the Environmental Protection Agency, and old batteries contain large amounts of lead and sulfuric acid.

All of it can be recycled, and mostly at no cost. Many auto part retailers and gas stations with service areas recycle used oil for free, leaving used tires with a tire retailer ensures proper disposal, some repair shops recycle antifreeze for a small fee, and battery retailers are required by law to recycle old batteries on request.
lessons.whyItMatters:
The litter law is one of the few offences in the handbook that a driver can commit while sitting still, and the penalty range is wide enough to be worth knowing: it starts at a $50 minimum and reaches a $1,000 maximum or a jail term.

The waste section answers a practical question that comes up the first time anyone changes their own oil: where does this go? The answer is that the place that sold you the product usually has to take the old one back, and that pouring it away can contaminate water on a scale out of all proportion to the amount involved.
lessons.example: You change your own oil and are left with a gallon of dirty oil and an old battery. The handbook's route is straightforward: many auto part retailers and gas stations with service areas recycle used oil for free, and battery retailers are required by law to recycle old batteries upon request. Tipping the oil down a drain instead is littering under West Virginia law, and that gallon is enough to ruin a million gallons of water.

Turn the radio up until you reach your destination
